_comment: The FIXED SERP probe query set for vibeops.ca. Do not add, remove or reword a query once frozen — the whole value of a fixed set is that it can show us we were wrong. If a query becomes genuinely irrelevant, set deprecated:true and KEEP MEASURING IT; do not delete the row.
_parity: scripts/seo/verify.mjs asserts this list matches the arrays embedded in probe.js. probe.js has to stay self-contained because it is pasted into a browser page context, so the two copies are checked rather than shared. Regenerate the probe arrays with `npm run seo:sync-probe` rather than editing them by hand.
_how_this_set_was_chosen: Built from the site's own positioning rather than from a keyword tool, deliberately. The six problem clusters come from documented discovery with 100+ AE professionals (see src/data/jobs.ts), so they are the language real buyers used, not the language a volume estimator suggests. That is a bet: it optimises for intent match over search volume. If after several weeks these queries show near-zero impressions while Search Console discloses a completely different vocabulary, the bet was wrong and the DISCOVERY set (discovery-queries.json) is where that correction gets made. The benchmark itself stays frozen so the correction is visible as a difference rather than hidden by a rewrite.
_expect_zeros: Most of these will read 0 for a long time. This is a 16-page consultancy site competing against established agencies and directories. A frozen set of zeros that slowly becomes a set of ranked positions is exactly the measurement being taken; do not treat early zeros as a defect or as a reason to reword the set.
